policy.slowTests: Defer expensive suites until the integrated candidate is stable; one Luna max owner; prefer completion events; no duplicate runs or frequent lead polling
policy.handoff: After local acceptance, open or update a PR for external review with necessary tested migration files; do not merge, enable auto-merge, deploy, or apply hosted migrations

comparisonRule: Compare total cost and quality only for the same task and required gates; include retries, repair, review and human effort.
